cases.ref_text: MISTER QUILTER IS THE APOSTLE OF THE MIDDLE CLASSES AND WE ARE GLAD TO WELCOME HIS GOSPEL
cases.text: The morning train arrived on time, and we walked along the river before breakfast. A small boat passed beneath the old stone bridge while the shops were opening on the opposite bank. After a short rest, we bought some fresh bread and returned to the station, where our friends were waiting to hear about the journey and make plans for the rest of the day.

cases.ref_text: 羊城晚报五月八日报道今年的母亲节五月十日
cases.text: 今天下午天气晴朗，我们准备沿着河边散步，然后去附近的书店看看。路上如果遇到认识的朋友，就邀请他们一起喝杯茶，聊聊最近的工作和生活。等太阳快要落山的时候，我们再坐公交车回家，准备一顿简单的晚饭。晚饭后，再把今天拍的照片发给家人。
